punchlist.hotkey.comment.punchListFilter:
Toggles the PunchList filter on/off.
While on, only Schematic Verifier-selected mismatch
positions are rendered, and the schematic ray trace
passes through everything else.
punchlist.message.filter_on_empty: PunchList filter ON - no verifier selection, showing everything
punchlist.message.verifier_error: PunchList: error reading verifier data, filter showing everything
punchlist.message.incompatible: PunchList disabled: incompatible Litematica/MaLiLib version (see log)
